PART 1: Identify some simple Christian rituals for- 2.

What this means
In this part you learn to identify some simple Christian rituals for- 2.. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify some simple Christian rituals for- 2..
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify some simple Christian rituals for- 2.. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify some simple Christian rituals for- 2.)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify some simple Christian rituals for- 2..
3. Make one local Kenya example of Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS?
